messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy #r4567] BLOCKED: SBOM_ALERT - transitive package flagged in release v1.12.3. Package: libxyz (transitive via sdk-builder). CVE-2026-1234 (medium). Pipeline: http://ci/pipe/r4567 - reviewer: @ashley
ashley: I see it, thanks. Triage incoming. @cheng can you assess runtime exploitability? If it's build-only maybe we can patch without rolling back the entire release.
cheng: quick triage: looks like a build-tool (pulled into builder image), not a runtime library. Path: app -> sdk -> builder-tool -> libxyz. No public exploits reported. Severity medium but low runtime exposure.
oliver: if it's build-time-only then app binaries unaffected. What's the effort to rebuild/pin vs full rollback?
qa-jen: my canary for r4567 in staging shows no regressions so far. If we rebuild the image with a pinned builder digest and run a limited eu-west-1 canary we can probably keep schedule. Need ~45m for QA regression.
devops-maya: we can produce a patched image tag `v1.12.3-patch.1` that pins the builder image digest. CI will emit a new SBOM with the pinned hash. I can queue the build once we decide.
ashley: proposal: hold the global rollout, create patched image, run a 1-hour limited canary in eu-west-1. If canary is green, proceed staged rollout. Keep previous image available for immediate rollback (2h retention). Change window: start in 30m, duration 2h. Opinions? :eyes:
cheng: +1 to patch-forward canary. Also recommend we run an SBOM diff after the build and add a short regression check to the eval job.
legal-bot: license check: libxyz pinned version OK, no new license or export flags. Please add artifact provenance note to release notes.
oliver: +1. I'll add a short note in release notes: 'Addressed SBOM transitive tool vulnerability by pinning builder image; canary verified'. I'll shepherd the notes.
deploy-bot: Actions queued: `hold-global-rollout`, create build job `r4567-patch`, run canary in eu-west-1, keep `r4567-prev` image as rollback target. Will post updates when jobs start/finish.
nashley: thanks. Maya, please run the patched image build and post new SBOM hash here. I'll update the change window and ping infra-oncall @cheng if anything looks off.
devops-maya: kicked off build job `4567-patch` at 2312347000. New image sha256:abcdef1234567890deadbeef... SBOM now shows libxyz@2.4.1 (pinned). Artifacts: http://ci/build/4567-patch
qa-jen: canary started in eu-west-1. Running full regression suite, ETA ~42m. Will report pass/fail.
nashley: marking this thread for post-release follow-up. If canary fails we hit rollback button to restore `r4567-prev`.
devops-maya: canary passed green at 2312349000. Proceeding with staged rollout across remaining regions over next 90m. Release notes updated with provenance and SBOM entry. :tada:
